mapper.select: SELECT a.id, a.title, a.summary, a.cover_image, a.category_id, a.views, a.status, a.created_at, a.updated_at, COALESCE(cc.cnt, 0) AS comment_count FROM articles a LEFT JOIN (SELECT article_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM comments WHERE status = 'approved' GROUP BY article_id) cc ON cc.article_id = a.id WHERE a.status = 'published' ORDER BY a.created_at DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM articles WHERE status = 'published'
SELECT id, title, content, summary, cover_image, category_id, views, status, created_at, updated_at FROM articles WHERE status = 'published' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT id, created_at, updated_at FROM articles WHERE status = 'published' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT a.id, a.title, a.summary, a.cover_image, a.category_id, a.views, a.status, a.created_at, a.updated_at, COALESCE(cc.cnt, 0) AS comment_count FROM articles a LEFT JOIN (SELECT article_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM comments WHERE status = 'approved' GROUP BY article_id) cc ON cc.article_id = a.id WHERE a.status = 'published' AND (LOWER(a.title) LIKE LOWER(CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')) ESCAPE '/' OR LOWER(a.content) LIKE LOWER(CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')) ESCAPE '/') ORDER BY a.created_at DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM articles WHERE status = 'published' AND (LOWER(title) LIKE LOWER(CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')) ESCAPE '/' OR LOWER(content) LIKE LOWER(CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')) ESCAPE '/')
SELECT id, title, content, summary, cover_image, category_id, views, status, created_at, updated_at FROM articles WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT DISTINCT a.id, a.title, a.summary, a.cover_image, a.category_id, a.views, a.status, a.created_at, a.updated_at FROM articles a LEFT JOIN article_tags at2 ON a.id = at2.article_id AND at2.tag_id IN (SELECT tag_id FROM article_tags WHERE article_id = #{articleId}) WHERE a.status = 'published' AND (a.category_id = #{categoryId} OR at2.tag_id IS NOT NULL) AND a.id != #{articleId} ORDER BY a.created_at DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT a.id, a.title, a.summary, a.cover_image, a.category_id, a.views, a.status, a.created_at, a.updated_at, COALESCE(cc.cnt, 0) AS comment_count FROM articles a LEFT JOIN (SELECT article_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM comments WHERE status = 'approved' GROUP BY article_id) cc ON cc.article_id = a.id WHERE a.category_id = #{categoryId} AND a.status = 'published' ORDER BY a.created_at DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM articles WHERE category_id = #{categoryId} AND status = 'published'

SELECT DISTINCT a.id, a.title, a.summary, a.cover_image, a.category_id, a.views, a.status, a.created_at, a.updated_at, COALESCE(cc.cnt, 0) AS comment_count FROM articles a JOIN article_tags at2 ON a.id = at2.article_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT article_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM comments WHERE status = 'approved' GROUP BY article_id) cc ON cc.article_id = a.id WHERE at2.tag_id = #{tagId} AND a.status = 'published' ORDER BY a.created_at DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.id) FROM articles a JOIN article_tags at2 ON a.id = at2.article_id WHERE at2.tag_id = #{tagId} AND a.status = 'published'

SELECT a.id, a.title, a.summary, a.cover_image, a.category_id, a.views, a.status, a.created_at, a.updated_at, COALESCE(cc.cnt, 0) AS comment_count FROM articles a LEFT JOIN (SELECT article_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM comments WHERE status = 'approved' GROUP BY article_id) cc ON cc.article_id = a.id WHERE a.status = 'published' AND a.created_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) ORDER BY (a.views + COALESCE(cc.cnt, 0) * 20) DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM articles WHERE status = 'published' AND created_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY)
